title: Feds: Mass. man shipped synthetic opioids in Cheetos, Pirate’s Booty bags
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Local News Federal prosecutors say a shipment allegedly sent by the 23-year-old caused a woman's overdose death in Las Vegas.
